name: Kazakiri Ayano
source:
The school nurse and advisor for the acting club, Ayano is a graduate of the school and daughter of the principal.
Extremely slow going, this warm-hearted beauty does everything at her own speed.
She also tends to help anyone in need.

[from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20071113213704/http://www.hirameki-int.com/apdvd/products/dayoflove/p_cha05.html]Hirameki[/url]]
